name: Chatbot IA Gratis – Asistente de Ventas y Atención al Cliente
author: eliseogamba

sections.description:
Chatbot IA Gratis adds an AI-powered chat assistant to your WordPress store. Once activated, the plugin automatically registers your site and adds a smart chat widget to every page — no manual setup required. It answers your visitors’ questions, assists them while they shop, and helps you convert more sales.

Key features

  • One-click setup — activating the plugin registers your site automatically using your WordPress admin details
  • Free plan included — 100 chat sessions per month at no cost
  • Pro plan available — upgrade to unlimited sessions directly from your WP dashboard
  • Fully customizable — set your welcome message and brand color from the WP admin
  • Knowledge base — add text entries to teach the bot about your products, policies, and FAQs
  • Enable / disable the chat widget without deactivating the plugin
  • Bilingual — admin interface available in English and Spanish

External service

This plugin connects to the AI assistant service operated by Tu Tienda Online (https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app) to:

  • Register your site and issue a unique API key on activation
  • Serve the chat widget JavaScript to your visitors
  • Process chat messages and generate AI responses

Data sent to the service includes your site URL, site name, and admin email (on registration), and visitor chat messages (during conversations). Please review the service’s privacy policy at https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app before using this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. On activation the plugin registers your site automatically — the chat widget appears on your store immediately.
  3. Go to Chatbot IA in your WordPress sidebar to customize the bot’s appearance and knowledge.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account?

No. The plugin creates one automatically using your WordPress admin email when you activate it.

What happens when I reach the free session limit?

The chat widget stops responding until the next month, or you can upgrade to Pro for unlimited sessions from the Chatbot IA settings page.

Can I turn off the chat widget temporarily?

Yes. Use the toggle in Chatbot IA → Settings to enable or disable the widget without deactivating the plugin.

Is my data safe?

Chat messages are processed by the Tu Tienda Online AI service. No data is stored beyond what is needed to generate responses and track session usage.

What languages does the admin interface support?

English and Spanish. The plugin automatically uses the language set in your WordPress installation.
